newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SEA SHIPPING COMPANY PROFIT DIPS IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: SEA SHIPPING COMPANY PROFIT DIPS IN 1996.

text.p: The state-run Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company said on Friday that its 1996 net profit sank to 55.8 million litas from 67.7 million litas the previous year.

The company also decided at its general shareholders' meeting on Thursday to pay dividends of 16.5 million litas, Arvydas Stropus, the head of the company's economy department, told Reuters by telephone.
The Lithuania Sea Shipping Company is 80 percent state-owned and has been slated for privatisation.
The company's share price rose in early trade on Friday at the Vilnius bourse to 7.59 litas from 6.90 litas.
